name: Renovation
description: The rooms we're redoing, the work in each, what we have to buy, and who's doing it.

room.description: A room or area being worked on, with what we can spend on it.

budget.description: the most we want to spend on purchases for this room

task.description: A piece of work, like tiling the floor or moving a socket.

in-room.description: the room this work happens in

needs.description: what has to arrive before this work can happen

purchase.description: Something to buy: materials, fixtures, appliances.

for-room.description: the room whose budget this comes out of

trade.description: A builder, plumber, electrician or anyone else doing the work.

add-room.title: Add a room
add-room.description: Add a room or area being worked on, optionally with a budget.

set-room-budget.title: Set the budget
set-room-budget.description: Set or change the most you want to spend on purchases for this room.

add-task.title: Add a task
add-task.description: Add a piece of work, before choosing its room.

add-task-here.title: Add a task in this room
add-task-here.description: Add a piece of work in this room, by title, with a due date if there is one.

start-task.title: Start
start-task.description: Say work on a task has begun.

finish-task.title: Done
finish-task.description: Say a task is finished; it drops out of view but is not deleted.

add-purchase.title: Add a purchase
add-purchase.description: Add something to buy, before choosing its room.

add-purchase-for-task.title: Add something this task needs
add-purchase-for-task.description: Add a thing to buy that this task cannot start without, by name, with cost and supplier if known.

add-purchase-for-room.title: Add a purchase for this room
add-purchase-for-room.description: Add a thing to buy that comes out of this room's budget.

mark-ordered.title: Mark as ordered
mark-ordered.description: Say a purchase has been ordered.

mark-delivered.title: Mark as delivered
mark-delivered.description: Say a purchase has arrived on site.

charge-to-room.title: Charge to a room
charge-to-room.description: Say which room's budget a purchase comes out of.
charge-to-room.fromTheOtherEnd: Charge one of our purchases to this room

needs-purchase.title: Waits on a purchase
needs-purchase.description: Say a task cannot start until a purchase arrives.
needs-purchase.fromTheOtherEnd: Say a task is waiting on this

no-longer-needs.title: No longer waits on a purchase
no-longer-needs.description: Say a task no longer waits on a purchase.
no-longer-needs.fromTheOtherEnd: Say a task no longer waits on this

move-task.title: Move to a room
move-task.description: Say which room a task happens in.
move-task.fromTheOtherEnd: Move one of our tasks to this room

add-trade.title: Add a tradesperson
add-trade.description: Add a builder, plumber, electrician or anyone else doing the work.

assign-trade.title: Give to a tradesperson
assign-trade.description: Say who is doing a task.
assign-trade.fromTheOtherEnd: Give them one of our tasks

uncharge.title: Take off a room's budget
uncharge.description: Stop charging a purchase to a room's budget.
uncharge.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a purchase off this room's budget

take-out-of-room.title: Take out of its room
take-out-of-room.description: Say a task no longer belongs to the room it was in.
take-out-of-room.fromTheOtherEnd: Take one of our tasks out of this room

unassign-trade.title: Take off a tradesperson
unassign-trade.description: Say a tradesperson is no longer doing a task.

order-what-work-waits-on.title: Nothing waits on a purchase not yet ordered
order-what-work-waits-on.description: A tiler booked for Monday with no tiles ordered is a lost week.
order-what-work-waits-on.says: {item} isn't ordered yet — waiting on it: {in('needs') where status != 'done'}

room-within-budget.title: A room's purchases fit its budget

grants.describe: Owners and editors may do everything; viewers can look.
